title: Commitment wallet and roadmap funnel for enterprise private deploys
creator: Asha Raman
description: Define and operationalize a 'commitment wallet' concept and a correlated roadmap funnel to ensure predictable capacity allocation, readiness gating, and OKR traceability for private/VPC/on‑prem enterprise customers. This ticket scopes the product and cross‑functional requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout sequencing, and the dashboards required to tie customer commitments to roadmap prioritization and release windows.
goals: Create a lightweight commitment wallet model that maps customer contractual commitments (reserved GPU hours, seats, support tier) to roadmap priority buckets
Establish a roadmap funnel with explicit gates (security, compatibility, capacity) to convert 'interest' -> 'engaged' -> 'ready-to-provision' cohorts
Provide OKR traceability: link wallet-driven commitments to quarterly OKRs and expected revenue/engagement outcomes
Deliver dashboards and alerts for capacity occupancy, gating failures, and on‑boarding velocity
acceptance_criteria: Product spec approved by Eng, Design, and Sales
Commitment wallet data model implemented in console backend (mocked data allowed for pilot)
Roadmap funnel UI wireframes approved and validated with two pilot customers
Dashboards report: committed vs available capacity, cohort progression, and SLA risk signals
Rollout runbook with rollback criteria and support playbook completed
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (alpha): feature flag + internal demo, 2 pilot customers from existing Dedicated list
Phase 1 (beta): enable wallet entries for customers in pilot cohort, collect onboarding metrics for 4 weeks
Phase 2 (general): open to all private customers with automated gating; integrate with Dedicated provisioning pipeline
Canary policy: new private deployments limited to 5% of capacity pool for first 72 hours; automatic fallback to hosted API on high error rates
Rollback: remove wallet assignment + deprovision reservation; notify customer success and sales; postmortem within 3 business days
metrics: time_to_onboard (days): target <= 14 for Tier A pilot
wallet_utilization_percent: target >= 70% within 30 days of provisioning
OKR_linked_revenue: dollar amount of quarterly commitments tied to feature gating
updates: 2025-02-10: Initial scoping draft completed; synced with Eng (Mateo) and Design (Priya). Decided wallet should be a first-class object in console model rather than ad-hoc tags.
2025-02-17: Sales leadership (Rafael) shared list of 12 target customers; segmented into Tier A/B/C for pilot eligibility. Identified two customers willing to pilot with NDA.

2025-02-24: Eng capacity spike review: allocation algorithm options discussed (static reservations vs sliding percent). Leaning to sliding percent to improve utilization but requires stronger circuit-breakers.
2025-03-01: Security sign-off needed for onprem key-handling in wallet UI flows; security requested KMS integration plan before beta. Marked as dependency.
2025-03-04: Design delivered high-level wireframes focused on commitment entry, wallet dashboard, and cohort funnel. Next: implement backend prototyping and pilot runbook.
Blockers: KMS integration design (security), Dedicated provisioning API edge cases (ENG-47211), legal review for commitment language.
customer_cohorts: Tier A - Enterprise + SLA + Dedicated GPU
